caseGroups.sourceSupportedInterpretation: Code 1 includes Declined—All other transactions (and separately Approved—Communications Test). A decline value is compatible with the transaction family, but the cited source does not establish that this exact missing-field request must return code 1.

Appendix G defines all four as approved Electronic Mail/proprietary-data response states. It does not select one for these cases or supply the host pending-data state; candidate flags explicitly report that dependency.
